verdict.rationale: kitty is configured through a documented plain-text kitty.conf file, which is the core of a dotfiles-friendly setup. Community reports corroborate that configuration is text-based: one user wishes there were a GUI config method, and others call it easy to configure. Missing for 10: the pack has only page titles for the conf docs, with no detail on the file location or includes/splitting config, and no explicit evidence of portability or syncing across machines.
